definitions.gloss: food left on the plate; leftovers
definitions.explanation: Food that someone has served or started and not finished, left on the plate or table. It is the noun of {食|た}べ{残|のこ}す; food deliberately kept for later is more often {残|のこ}り{物|もの}.

examples.english: Don't leave food on your plate.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{残|のこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}って→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I take the leftovers home?

examples.japanese: ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|た}べ{残|のこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Efforts to reduce food left over at banquets are spreading.

notes:
Leaving food is widely seen as bad manners and wasteful (⟦もったいない→もったいない：02642_mottainai⟧) in Japan, and children are taught to finish their plates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{残|のこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave food uneaten
- {食|た}べ{残|のこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}る→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧: to take leftovers home
- {食|た}べ{残|のこ}し⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: zero food waste (campaign slogan)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{残|のこ}り{物|もの}→残り物：18299_nokorimono⟧: leftovers kept for later; also anything left over
- ⟦{食|た}べかけ→食べかけ：33954_tabekake⟧: half-eaten — the food is still being eaten
